## Introducing the New PIP Pipeline 
::: {style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8; max-width:860px; margin:0 auto 1.2em auto; text-align:center;"}
An interconnected ecosystem of R packages — each covering a distinct pipeline stage, all sharing the same guarantees: release-scoped, versioned, validated, logged, and tracks changes.
:::

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:14px; margin-bottom:18px;">

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border-left:3px solid #38BDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px;">
<div style="font-weight:700; color:#E2E8F0; font-size:0.85em; margin-bottom:4px;">Release-scoped by design</div>
<div style="font-size:0.72em; color:#94A3B8; margin-bottom:10px;">Every artifact is tied to a working release — nothing floats outside a versioned context.</div>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38BDF8; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px;">{pipfun}</span>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border-left:3px solid #38BDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px;">
<div style="font-weight:700; color:#E2E8F0; font-size:0.85em; margin-bottom:4px;">Smart, dependency-aware rebuilding</div>
<div style="font-size:0.72em; color:#94A3B8; margin-bottom:10px;">Steps are never reprocessed without a reason — changes propagate only where needed.</div>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38BDF8; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px; margin-right:4px;">{pipfun}</span>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(129,140,248,0.15); color:#A5B4FC; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px;">{stamp}</span>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(129,140,248,0.07); border-left:3px solid #818CF8; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px;">
<div style="font-weight:700; color:#E2E8F0; font-size:0.85em; margin-bottom:4px;">Versioning & time-travel</div>
<div style="font-size:0.72em; color:#94A3B8; margin-bottom:10px;">Content-hashed artifacts with full lineage tracking — any version, any point in time.</div>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(129,140,248,0.15); color:#A5B4FC; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px;">{stamp}</span>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border-left:3px solid #38BDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px;">
<div style="font-weight:700; color:#E2E8F0; font-size:0.85em; margin-bottom:4px;">Audit logging & error resilience</div>
<div style="font-size:0.72em; color:#94A3B8; margin-bottom:10px;">Every step is logged — successes, warnings, failures. The pipeline never fails silently.</div>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38BDF8; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px;">{pipfun}</span>

<div style="background:rgba(52,211,153,0.07); border-left:3px solid #34D399; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px;">

<div style="font-size:0.72em; color:#94A3B8; margin-bottom:10px;">Input and output checks at every stage — errors caught early, never propagated silently.</div>
<span style="font-family:monospace; font-size:0.75em; background:rgba(52,211,153,0.15); color:#34D399; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 7px; margin-right:4px;">{pipdata}</span>

# Auxiliary Data - The Big Picture {.section-slide .center}

::: subtitle-text
What is the aux data pipeline responsible for? How is it built?
:::

---

## One main orchestrator - `{pipaux}`

::: {style="font-size:0.85em; color:#94A3B8; max-width:820px; margin:0 auto 1em auto; text-align:center;"}
An R package that manages the 20+ auxiliary measures that feed the World Bank's global poverty estimates. For example, price data, national accounts, demographics and poverty measurement parameters.
:::

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:22px;">

<div style="font-size:0.9em; line-height:1.8; color:#CBD5E1; border-left:3px solid #334155; padding-left:16px;">
Takes [raw data from different sources]{.text-accent}, [cleans, validates, and formats]{.text-success} each one into [ready-to-use datasets]{.text-accent} for PIP's poverty estimates.
</div>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.25); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 18px;">
<div style="font-size:0.72em; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#38BDF8; margin-bottom:6px;">Responsibility 1</div>
<div style="font-weight:700; font-size:0.95em; color:#E2E8F0; margin-bottom:5px;">Update & Synchronization Pipeline</div>
<div style="font-size:0.78em; color:#94A3B8; line-height:1.5;">Raw &rarr; validated &rarr; versioned artifacts on the Y-drive — dependency-ordered, rebuilt only when something changed.</div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(52,211,153,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.25); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 18px;">
<div style="font-size:0.72em; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#34D399; margin-bottom:6px;">Responsibility 2</div>
<div style="font-weight:700; font-size:0.95em; color:#E2E8F0; margin-bottom:5px;">Comparison Engine</div>
<div style="font-size:0.78em; color:#94A3B8; line-height:1.5;">Structured diff reports across releases and within-release vintages.</div>
</div>


</div>
</div>

## Aux Data Pipeline Objectives

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px; margin-top:0.4em;">

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.2); border-left:3px solid #38BDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0;">1</span>
<div><span class="text-accent" style="font-weight:600;">Consistent raw data management</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">GitHub as a reliable, release-linked staging area for all raw inputs</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.2); border-left:3px solid #38BDF8; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0;">2</span>
<div><span class="text-accent" style="font-weight:600;">Automated processing for every measure</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Pipelines triggered only when needed — avoiding redundant rebuilds while never missing a required update</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(52,211,153,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.2); border-left:3px solid #34D399; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#34D399;">3</span>
<div><span class="text-success" style="font-weight:600;">Dependency-aware execution</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">A dependency graph that resolves order and propagates changes automatically</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(52,211,153,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.2); border-left:3px solid #34D399; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#34D399;">4</span>
<div><span class="text-success" style="font-weight:600;">Double-stage data validation</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Validation checks at both input and output stages for every measure</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(251,191,36,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.2); border-left:3px solid #FBBF24; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#FBBF24; color:#0D1B2A;">5</span>
<div><span class="text-warning" style="font-weight:600;">Release-scoped outputs</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Every output file is explicitly tied to a specific production release</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(251,191,36,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.2); border-left:3px solid #FBBF24; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#FBBF24; color:#0D1B2A;">6</span>
<div><span class="text-warning" style="font-weight:600;">Versioning and traceability</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Every version of every dataset is saved with full metadata — always accessible, always traceable</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(129,140,248,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(129,140,248,0.2); border-left:3px solid #818CF8; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#818CF8;">7</span>
<div><span style="font-weight:600; color:#A5B4FC;">Full audit logging & error resilience</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Every step is logged — successes, failures, and errors — so the pipeline never fails silently</span></div>
</div>

<div style="background:rgba(129,140,248,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(129,140,248,0.2); border-left:3px solid #818CF8; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;">
<span class="step-badge" style="flex-shrink:0; background:#818CF8;">8</span>
<div><span style="font-weight:600; color:#A5B4FC;">Cross-release comparison</span><br><span style="font-size:0.8em; color:#94A3B8;">Tools that surface what changed, where, and when — across releases and vintages</span></div>
</div>

</div>
